aliases: Inherited label-developed vocabulary; frozen in this experiment
g0: Runtime reference overrides and equal four-value scalar scan in protocol.json
evaluation: Seven complete validation sets; targets loaded after predictions
snapshots: configs/vocabularies copied from previous frozen experiment; protocol runtime g0 overrides take precedence
tuning_policy: Alias banks, templates, background rules, local score calibration and wide-view policy are frozen snapshots inherited from prior task-adapted development. The Anchored run does not jointly retune them; only the predeclared g0 grid is compared.
strict_claim_boundary: Do not describe the historical pipeline as g0-only tuning. A clean g0-only claim requires a new protocol that freezes language and calibration choices before evaluation.
